name: ct_head_cspine_fall_anticoagulated
scan_type: CT head and CT cervical spine
clinical_history: 81F mechanical fall at home on apixaban for AF. GCS 14, right-sided scalp haematoma, midline cervical tenderness. Query intracranial haemorrhage, query cervical spine fracture.
findings:
- Thin acute subdural haematoma over the right frontal convexity, 6mm maximal thickness, no midline shift
- Small right frontal scalp haematoma, no underlying skull fracture
- Old left lacunar infarcts in the basal ganglia
- Generalised involutional change and chronic small vessel disease
- Minimally displaced type II odontoid peg fracture, 2mm anterior displacement, no retropulsion into the canal
- Alignment otherwise maintained, prevertebral soft tissues normal
- Multilevel cervical spondylosis, most marked C5/6 and C6/7
- Lung apices clear

name: ct_ncap_lymphoma_staging
scan_type: CT neck, chest, abdomen and pelvis with contrast
clinical_history: 45M, 3 months of painless left neck lump, night sweats and 6kg weight loss. Core biopsy: classical Hodgkin lymphoma. Staging.
findings:
- Bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy, largest left level II node 3.2cm, conglomerate left level III-IV nodes
- Anterior mediastinal nodal mass 6.5cm with bilateral hilar nodes
- No pleural or pericardial effusion, lungs clear
- Splenomegaly 16cm with two hypodense splenic lesions largest 1.8cm
- Retroperitoneal and para-aortic lymphadenopathy, largest 2.4cm short axis
- Liver normal, no focal lesion
- No pelvic or inguinal lymphadenopathy
- No focal bone lesion

name: mri_brain_whole_spine_demyelination
scan_type: MRI brain and whole spine with contrast
clinical_history: 29F, painful loss of vision right eye 2 weeks ago, now bilateral leg paraesthesia and urgency. Query demyelination.
findings:
- Multiple ovoid periventricular and juxtacortical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions, several perpendicular to the callososeptal interface
- One right periventricular lesion shows ring enhancement
- Right optic nerve mildly swollen with enhancement in the intraorbital segment
- No infratentorial lesion
- Short segment intramedullary T2 hyperintense lesion at C3, dorsal cord, less than one vertebral body, non-enhancing
- Further small lesion at T5, non-enhancing
- No cord expansion or atrophy
- Conus normal, terminates L1, no cauda equina abnormality
- No vertebral or disc abnormality

name: ct_aortogram_runoff_acute_limb
scan_type: CT aortogram thorax abdomen pelvis with lower limb run-off
clinical_history: 70M sudden onset painful cold pale left leg 4 hours, absent left pedal pulses, known AF not anticoagulated. Query acute limb ischaemia.
findings:
- Abrupt occlusion of the left superficial femoral artery at the adductor canal with reconstitution of the popliteal artery via collaterals
- Left tibial vessels opacify faintly, two vessel run-off
- Right lower limb arteries patent with mild diffuse atheroma
- Thoracic and abdominal aorta normal calibre, mild atheroma, no dissection or aneurysm
- Iliac arteries patent
- Incidental 4.1cm heterogeneously enhancing left renal mass, upper pole
- Lungs clear, no PE on this study
- Bones unremarkable

name: clean_ct_tavi_multisystem
findings: Left-sided pacemaker in situ. Severe coronary artery calcification and severe aortic valve calcification. The oesophagus is patulous and fluid-filled throughout its course. Small sliding hiatus hernia. There is diffuse sigmoid uncomplicated diverticulosis. Right total hip replacement noted. Severe degenerative change within the left hip.
